variants.name: Ashen Gold
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise HUD replacement in supplied gameplay screenshot. Create ONE finished 16:9 1920x1080 full-screen gameplay UI concept image for the original dark-fantasy game Veyr. The input is the EDIT TARGET and fixed visual backdrop. Preserve the exact armored knight, dragon, ruined cathedral, floor, moon, weather, camera, lighting and game-render quality. Do not beautify or repaint the environment or change the characters. Crop away the 32px macOS window title bar and all OS chrome. Remove ALL existing HUD, labels, icons, cursor, capture badge and the central CLICK OR ENTER TO BEGIN/tutorial text; reconstruct only the tiny background areas they covered. Replace with the new HUD specified below. No concept-board title, design annotations, inset panels, logos, watermarks or desktop frame. This is a credible in-combat HUD, not a poster or menu. Keep the central 70% of the action unobstructed. All elements must have consistent scale, crisp edges, restrained contrast, readable small typography and generous edge margins, like a carefully art-directed premium console dark-fantasy action RPG. Only show player health, stamina, equipped boat-shaped wooden greatsword, healing cup with 3 charges, one-hand grip state, boss health and one tiny lock-on diamond at dragon chest. No map, XP, mana, quests, compass, extra abilities or decorative fake text. Health shown around 78%, stamina 62%, boss health 68% so the fill and remaining track are visible. Sword icon must look like a long handle with an actual miniature wooden boat hull at the end, not a generic steel sword. Healing icon is a handled drinking cup with warm ember light. Exact boss text: "Veyr, the Cinder Warden". The knight remains the main focal point; UI ornament must not dominate the frame.
DESIGN A — ASHEN GOLD. The most refined, restrained classic Souls-inspired direction. Warm aged brass and dark oxblood against almost-black engraved iron; beautifully balanced original medieval serif typography. Top left: a small worn circular heraldic crest approximately 40px across, with two elegantly tapered horizontal gauges extending right about 300px, deep garnet health above muted olive stamina, thin burnished-gold rims and soft charcoal inset tracks. No HEALTH/STAMINA labels. Bottom left: two compact square relic slots in a horizontal pair, finely engraved borders, dark textured interiors, realistically hand-painted boat-greatsword and ember-cup icons; small "E" key hint and "ONE HAND" below weapon, "Q" and large readable "3" at healing icon. Keep these small, like normal gameplay equipment slots, not giant inventory cards. Boss at bottom center: 60%-screen-width dark garnet bar with exquisitely thin antique-gold frame and tiny pointed endcaps, exact boss name centered just above in ivory small-caps serif. Delicate ornament only at crest and endcaps, no scrollwork sprawling into gameplay. Tiny warm ivory hollow diamond on boss chest. Cohesive high-quality metal/engraving craft, no cheap flat outlined rectangles, no oversized icons. Render no design-name label.
